title: Fisher-Shaped EWC on permuted digits
setting: Sequential domain-incremental learning on sklearn digits (8x8, standardized) where each task applies a different fixed pixel permutation, with a single-head 64-32-10 MLP trained by minibatch SGD and no replay. Online EWC (normalized, damped diagonal empirical Fisher) is compared with FS-EWC (SAM-style worst-case empirical FIM-trace penalty within an L2 ball of radius rho, plus averaging the last 10 iterates into the retained anchor) and a merging-only ablation. The metric is mean held-out test accuracy over all tasks after the final task; diagnostics include forgetting, last-task accuracy, and accuracy under a fixed-norm random parameter drift.

paper.title: Beyond Parameter Protection: Fisher-Shaped EWC for Replay-Free Continual Learning
paper.claim: Shaping solutions by minimizing worst-case neighborhood FIM trace and merging the optimization trajectory, on top of EWC, yields a better stability-plasticity balance and higher final accuracy than standard EWC.

metric.name: avg_final_acc
metric.description: Mean test accuracy over all tasks after training on the last task (held-out digits, each task's own pixel permutation).

factors.name: method
factors.description: ewc: online EWC with terminal iterate as anchor; fs_ewc: EWC plus worst-case FIM-trace shaping and last-K trajectory averaging; merge_only: EWC plus trajectory averaging without FIM shaping (ablation).

factors.name: ewc_lambda
factors.description: Strength of the EWC quadratic penalty (weak to strong protection).

factors.name: n_tasks
factors.description: Number of sequential permuted-pixel tasks; more tasks mean more accumulated drift and capacity pressure.

factors.name: rho
factors.description: L2 radius of the neighborhood for the worst-case FIM-trace term (only affects fs_ewc).
